method: Each of first 60 manifest originals displayed individually via view_image (high detail), six batches of ten; not contact-sheet-only review. Labels reflect observed garment evidence. No training admission, rights approval, or split assigned here.
limitations: Single agent review, not independently human-confirmed.
No exhaustive comparison with 1000 prior positives or 90 prior negatives in this subtask.
Catalog/session grouping proposals need conservative connected grouping before splitting.
Dress labels mean no standalone skirt; a dress lower portion is not a separate skirt.
